Error bar objects

Source: R/zz-gen-shared.R
go_error_bar.Rd

Used for error_x, error_y, error_z in 11 places in the schema. go_error_bar() creates one; a named list with the same properties works too.

Usage

go_error_bar(
  ...,
  array = NULL,
  arrayminus = NULL,
  color = NULL,
  copy_ystyle = NULL,
  copy_zstyle = NULL,
  symmetric = NULL,
  thickness = NULL,
  traceref = NULL,
  tracerefminus = NULL,
  type = NULL,
  value = NULL,
  valueminus = NULL,
  visible = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

Arguments

...

Not for properties, which must be named in full: an abbreviated or unknown name is an error that suggests the right one.

array

Sets the data corresponding the length of each error bar. Values are plotted relative to the underlying data. Data array: a vector, factor, Date/POSIXct vector, matrix or list.

arrayminus

Sets the data corresponding the length of each error bar in the bottom (left) direction for vertical (horizontal) bars Values are plotted relative to the underlying data. Data array: a vector, factor, Date/POSIXct vector, matrix or list.

color

Sets the stroke color of the error bars. Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

copy_ystyle

Logical. Not available in every context.

copy_zstyle

Logical. Not available in every context.

symmetric

Determines whether or not the error bars have the same length in both direction (top/bottom for vertical bars, left/right for horizontal bars. Logical.

thickness

Sets the thickness (in px) of the error bars. Number in the interval [0, Inf].

traceref

Integer in the interval [0, Inf].

tracerefminus

Integer in the interval [0, Inf].

type

Determines the rule used to generate the error bars. If "constant", the bar lengths are of a constant value. Set this constant in `value`. If "percent", the bar lengths correspond to a percentage of underlying data. Set this percentage in `value`. If "sqrt", the bar lengths correspond to the square of the underlying data. If "data", the bar lengths are set with data set `array`. One of "percent", "constant", "sqrt", "data".

value

Sets the value of either the percentage (if `type` is set to "percent") or the constant (if `type` is set to "constant") corresponding to the lengths of the error bars. Number in the interval [0, Inf].

valueminus

Sets the value of either the percentage (if `type` is set to "percent") or the constant (if `type` is set to "constant") corresponding to the lengths of the error bars in the bottom (left) direction for vertical (horizontal) bars Number in the interval [0, Inf].

visible

Determines whether or not this set of error bars is visible. Logical.

width

Sets the width (in px) of the cross-bar at both ends of the error bars. Number in the interval [0, Inf].

skip_invalid

If TRUE, silently drop invalid properties instead of raising an error.

Value

A go_error_bar object (a named list).

Details

These objects appear in 11 places in the plotly.js schema (properties named error_x, error_y, error_z), with small differences between them: for example, not every context has every property below. go_error_bar() checks the values against the contexts it can be used in; when the object is placed in a figure it is checked again against that context's rules.

Examples

mtcars |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_scatter(
    x = ~wt,
    y = ~mpg,
    mode = "markers",
    error_x = go_error_bar(color = "red")
  )
